label: HARMLESS_REFACTOR
rationale: Commit 1932d654cf7a ('docs(auto-entrepreneur): Rend publique la règle taux ACRE des auto-entrepreneurs', 2024-09-02 12:25:29 +0200) deletes exactly one line in one file of the rule library: the attribute `privé: oui` of the rule `dirigeant . auto-entrepreneur . cotisations et contributions . cotisations . taux ACRE` (modele-social/règles/dirigeant/auto-entrepreneur/exonérations.publicodes). `privé` is a publicodes visibility attribute (whether a rule may be referenced/evaluated/set from outside its namespace and shown in the documentation); it is not part of any formula, unit, default, threshold or applicability. Engine proof on a disposable AFTER tree (copy of G1 + the forward patch): build 641 raw rules on both sides; every value of every public rule is identical before and after (197 (situation, rule) pairs over 31 situations covering AE BNC/BIC/vente/CIPAV with and without ACRE at 01/09/2024, DROM, indépendant and salarié cases; 0 differences); the only observable change is exposure: the parsed-rule list grows from 1220 to 1227 names (`taux ACRE` and its six `avec` children become listed) and `taux ACRE` becomes evaluable (BEFORE: engine error "n'est pas accessible"; AFTER: 50 % for an AE created 01/03/2024 at 180 days with ACRE, null otherwise) with the same internal value it already contributed to the public rates (BNC 10.6 % / 106 €/mois with ACRE on both sides). sophon revalidate S4/G1 and S4/G1post_R2 give identical per-link results for all 113 pre-existing links. Law snapshot S4 (legi-data 2.384.0) is identical to S3 for all 12 bounded articles (same version ids and texts), so nothing on the law side changed either. This is documentation/metadata only: HARMLESS_REFACTOR. The 50 % ACRE value now exposed rests on a decree article outside the bounded set (L613-7 I only delegates it: 'fixé par décret') and the pre-existing misalignment of the AE rates with D613-4 v.LEGIARTI000049624068 (23,1 % BNC / 23,2 % CIPAV in force since 2024-07-01; library 21,1 / 21,2) exists identically on both sides; both are reported below, not as the label of this change.

outside_bounded_set: The decree article fixing the reduced global rate of ACRE-eligible micro-entrepreneurs (L613-7 I: 'Un taux global différent peut être fixé par décret ...'); D131-6-1 as given sets only the 12-month duration and the exemption formula of the non-micro regime. The library's 50 % (and the older 25/50/90 % and 25/75/90 % grids) cite URSSAF FAQ and service-public.fr pages, also outside the set. No value from these sources is asserted here.

L131-6-4 (conditions and beneficiaries of the ACRE), referenced by D131-6-1 I/II, is not in the bounded set; the library's applicability rule `dirigeant . exonérations . ACRE` is therefore not checked against text.
The semantics of `privé: oui` are engine documentation (publicodes), not law; they were established by running the engine (list 1220 -> 1227 names; evaluate error before / value after).
